issues.description: The text 'Continue' and 'Delete' are rendered with very low contrast against their background buttons, making them difficult to read. 'Continue' is yellow on a dark brown button, and 'Delete' is red on a dark brown button.
The text 'Region 1' and 'Cards: 0' are very small and have low contrast against the dark brown background, making them hard to read.
The text 'The Buried Age' has low contrast against the dark background, making it somewhat difficult to read.
